cr_data.provenance:
The artist, New York/Abiquiu, New Mexico, until 1986; By descent to the Estate of Georgia O’Keeffe, 1986-1993; Georgia O’Keeffe Foundation, Abiquiu, New Mexico, 1993-1994; Gift of the above to the Menil Foundation, Houston, 1994 
(Source: The Menil Collection, 2025)

titles.title: Early No. 2

credit_line: The Menil Collection, Houston, Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: In this abstract composition, a striped, black, white, and gray form sweeps upward from the bottom of the canvas and curls in on itself at the top. The form resembles the scroll of a violin or a sweeping piece of draped fabric.
title: Early No. 2
